# The least registration with any number of conditions / 任意多条件下最小的识

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`sensitivity-is-the-least-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](sensitivity-is-the-least-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A law reading finitely many conditions under each history reads through what it is sensitive to, with any number of conditions: sensitivity is the least registration. Given a decision of eventual vanishing, the tail law is a counterexample; with numbered conditions every counterexample gives WLPO.
>
> 律在每个历史下读有限多个条件时，无论条件多少，它经其敏感而读，敏感是它所经的最小的识。条件无穷多时这一条件不能去掉：给定消失之判定，尾之律不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别；条件编号时，每个反例都给出弱有限全知原则。

## Laws / 规律

1. A law reads within a list of conditions under a history where every history agreeing with it on them up to the step gives alike; it reads finitely many conditions where at every step, for every formation and under every history it reads within some list, the list possibly depending on the history (pointwise continuity). Such a law reads what has stood; with finitely many conditions every law of what has stood does.<br>律在一个历史下读一个条件列表之内，若每个在列出的条件上直到该步都与之相同的历史交换相同；律读有限多个条件，若在每一步、对每个形成、在每个历史下都读某个列表之内，列表可随历史而变（逐点连续）。这样的律读已立者；条件有限时每个读已立者的律都如此。 (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsWithin`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.nonanticipating`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.readsWithin_of_every`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.readsFinitely_of_every`)
2. A law of what has stood gives alike under two histories agreeing on what it is sensitive to wherever it reads within a list under one of them. So a law reading finitely many conditions, however many there are, reads through every registration observing what it is sensitive to, and every one it reads through holds that: sensitivity is the least registration, and the comparison as the dynamics give follows.<br>读已立者的律在两个于其所敏感者上相同的历史下交换相同，只要它在其中一个历史下读某个列表之内。所以读有限多个条件的律，无论条件多少，经每个观察其所敏感者的识而读，而它所经的每个识都不漏掉其敏感者：敏感是最小的识，由动力学给出的比较随之。 (`Becoming.alike_of_sensitive_agree_within`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_of_observed`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_sensitive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.least_registration`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive_of_every`, `Becoming.comparison_through_sensitivity_of_readsFinitely`)
3. At a step at which a law is insensitive to every condition, it gives alike under two histories wherever it reads within a list under one of them; a law reading finitely many conditions and sensitive to none gives alike everywhere: what depends on the whole depends on some part.<br>律在某步对每个条件都不敏感时，在两个历史下交换相同，只要它在其中一个历史下读某个列表之内；读有限多个条件而不敏感于任何条件的律处处交换相同：依存于整体者依存于某个部分。 (`Becoming.mixIn_alike_of_insensitiveAt`, `Becoming.alike_of_insensitiveAt_within`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.alike_of_insensitive`)
4. With infinitely many conditions the list's depending on the history cannot be dropped: a formation exchanging the level of the condition that condition 0's level names reads two conditions under each history, and within no one list under all of them.<br>条件无穷多时，列表随历史而变不能去掉：一个形成交换步 0 时条件 0 的水平所指那个条件的水平，它在每个历史下读两个条件，却不在任何一个列表之内读所有历史。 (`Becoming.Pointer.law`, `Becoming.Pointer.readsWithin`, `Becoming.Pointer.readsFinitely`, `Becoming.Pointer.beyond`, `Becoming.Pointer.lt_beyond`, `Becoming.Pointer.beyond_ne_zero`, `Becoming.Pointer.naming`, `Becoming.Pointer.namingOne`, `Becoming.Pointer.no_list`)
5. Given a decision, for every sequence of levels, of whether it vanishes from some condition on, the tail law exchanges that indicator: it reads what has stood and through the conditions from any one on, is insensitive to every condition and still differs between two histories; it does not read through what it is sensitive to, nor finitely many conditions, and the registrations it reads through have no least one.<br>给定对每个水平序列是否从某个条件起消失的判定，尾之律交换消失的指示：它读已立者，经识从任何一个条件起的全部条件而读，在每一步对每个条件都不敏感，却在两个历史之间不同；它不经其敏感而读，不读有限多个条件，它所经的识没有最小的。 (`Becoming.VanishFrom`, `Becoming.VanishFrom.of_agree`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_one`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_zero`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_eq_of_agree`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_zeros`, `Becoming.vanishIndicator_ones`, `Becoming.tailLaw`, `Becoming.tailLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.tailLaw_reads_from`, `Becoming.tailLaw_insensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_sensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_differs`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through`, `Becoming.tailLaw_through_from`, `Becoming.tailLaw_no_least_registration`, `Becoming.tailLaw_not_readsFinitely`)
6. With conditions numbered by the natural numbers, a law of what has stood giving differently under two histories agreeing on what it is sensitive to gives the weak limited principle of omniscience (every Boolean sequence is false throughout or not), as does any law insensitive at a step to every condition yet differing there. The decision of vanishing gives the limited principle.<br>条件以自然数编号时，读已立者的律若在两个于其所敏感者上相同的历史下交换不同，就给出弱有限全知原则（每个布尔序列处处为假或否）；在某步不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别的律亦然。消失之判定给出有限全知原则。 (`Becoming.WLPO`, `Becoming.WLPO.of_lpo`, `Becoming.Sensitivity.or_true`, `Becoming.seenBy`, `Becoming.seenBy_false`, `Becoming.seenBy_at`, `Becoming.seenBy_from`, `Becoming.seenBy_true`, `Becoming.alike_of_agree_from`, `Becoming.mixed_decides`, `Becoming.wlpo_of_insensitive_differs`, `Becoming.Sensitivity.cond_either`, `Becoming.alike_of_agree_from_sensitive`, `Becoming.wlpo_of_not_through_sensitive`, `Becoming.seenBy_exists`, `Becoming.lpo_of_vanish_decided`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the law reads finitely many conditions (ReadsFinitely) or what has stood (Nonanticipating); decided equality of conditions only for mixing conditions; the tail law takes as a hypothesis a decision, for every sequence of levels, of whether it vanishes eventually; the theorems of omniscience number the conditions by the natural numbers.<br>不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：律读有限多个条件（ReadsFinitely）或读已立者（Nonanticipating）；条件的相等可判定只用于混合条件；尾之律以对每个水平序列是否终将消失的判定为假设；全知原则的定理以自然数为条件编号。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That every law reads finitely many conditions: a continuity principle, independent of the core, which the core neither asserts nor denies.<br>每个律都读有限多个条件：这是连续性原则，独立于核心，核心既不断言也不否定它。
- With infinitely many conditions, reading what has stood does not imply reading through what one is sensitive to (given the decision of vanishing).<br>条件无穷多时，读已立者不推出经其敏感而读（给定消失之判定）。 Witness: `Becoming.tailLaw_not_through_sensitive`.
- Reading finitely many conditions does not imply reading within one list under every history.<br>读有限多个条件不推出在一个列表之内读所有历史。 Witness: `Becoming.Pointer.no_list`.
- Exactly where between the weak limited principle and the decision of vanishing the existence of a counterexample lies; what a counterexample gives where the conditions are not numbered by the natural numbers.<br>反例之存在在弱有限全知原则与消失之判定之间的确切位置；条件不以自然数编号时反例给出什么。
- A measure of sensitivity (how much a formation's exchange depends on a condition) or of how much difference arrives; sensitivity read in temporal order; continuous time.<br>敏感的度量（形成的交换依存于一个条件多少）与差别到达多少；按时间先后读的敏感；连续时间。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The tail law (given the decision of vanishing): it reads what has stood, is sensitive to no condition and still differs, and the registrations it reads through have no least one: without continuity the least registration fails.<br>尾之律（给定消失之判定）：读已立者，不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别，它所经的识没有最小的：没有连续性时，最小的识不成立。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sensitivity.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 12 October 2026, the goal: “move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”. This result answers the next_delta of counterfactual-is-the-course: whether, with infinitely many conditions, sensitivity remains the least registration, or a counterexample. It does wherever the law reads finitely many conditions under each history; otherwise it need not, and with numbered conditions no counterexample can be given in the core without a principle of omniscience. Readings (the AI's, adopted with exact scope on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D37; 识 itself stays Ren's): registration is sensitivity, a formation registering exactly what its exchange can be changed by, one condition at a time; what depends on the whole depends on some part; what depends on the whole and on no part of it is a tail, like eventual vanishing or a long-run average, the counterpart without probability of Kolmogorov's tail events; that every law reads finitely many conditions is Brouwer's continuity principle, which refutes the weak limited principle and which the core neither states nor refutes.<br>Ren 2026-10-12 的目标：“move towards 100%, you can spawn a few agents for help, pick the "What would move it most next" first, and don't stop until we are 100%”。本结果回答 counterfactual-is-the-course 的 next_delta：条件无穷多时敏感是否仍是最小的识，或有反例。凡律在每个历史下读有限多个条件，是；不然不必，而条件编号时，反例在核心中不经全知原则不能给出。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托以确切范围采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D37；识本身仍是 Ren 的）：识就是敏感，形成恰识其交换所能被改变者，一次一个条件；依存于整体者依存于某个部分；依存于整体而不依存于任何部分者是尾，如终将消失或长程平均，是 Kolmogorov 尾事件不带概率的对应；每个律都读有限多个条件是 Brouwer 的连续性原则，它驳斥弱有限全知原则，核心既不陈述也不驳斥它。
